---
title: "Olympic Beach Volleyball: Road to Gold"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/data-prep.R")

summer_volleyball <- summer_athletes |>
  filter(sport == "Volleyball")

volleyball_age_records <- summer_volleyball |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  mutate(
    competition = factor(
      if_else(
        str_detect(event, beach_event),
        "Beach volleyball",
        "Indoor volleyball"
      ),
      levels = c("Indoor volleyball", "Beach volleyball")
    ),
    gender = recode(sex, M = "Men", F = "Women"),
    country_label = str_remove(team, "-[0-9]+$"),
    medal_label = coalesce(as.character(medal), "Not reported in source"),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", name, "</b>",
      "<br>Age: ", age, " years",
      "<br>Country/team: ", country_label, " (", noc, ")",
      "<br>Olympic year: ", year,
      "<br>Event: ", event,
      "<br>Medal status: ", medal_label
    )
  )

beach_plot_count <- sum(volleyball_age_records$competition == "Beach volleyball")
indoor_plot_count <- sum(volleyball_age_records$competition == "Indoor volleyball")
beach_edition_count <- dplyr::n_distinct(beach_athletes$year)
volleyball_athlete_count <- dplyr::n_distinct(volleyball_age_records$id)
maximum_recorded_age <- max(volleyball_age_records$age)
beach_median_age <- median(
  volleyball_age_records$age[
    volleyball_age_records$competition == "Beach volleyball"
  ]
)
indoor_median_age <- median(
  volleyball_age_records$age[
    volleyball_age_records$competition == "Indoor volleyball"
  ]
)
```

## Olympic volleyball ages, at a glance

Each point is one age-reported person-event record. Beach volleyball is highlighted; indoor Volleyball provides historical context. Small, seeded jitter separates overlapping points without adding or removing records.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: !expr 'paste0("Source: olympicAthletes::olympic_athletes. Each point is one age-reported Summer Olympic Volleyball athlete-event record (", scales::comma(nrow(volleyball_age_records)), " of ", scales::comma(nrow(summer_volleyball)), "); gold highlights all ", scales::comma(beach_plot_count), " beach volleyball records from 1996–2024.")'

volleyball_chart <- ggplot(
  volleyball_age_records,
  aes(
    x = age,
    y = year,
    color = competition,
    alpha = competition,
    size = competition,
    text = hover_text
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.35, height = 0.25, seed = 2024)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Indoor volleyball" = "#667f89",
      "Beach volleyball" = "#bd9146"
    )
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(
      "Indoor volleyball" = 0.14,
      "Beach volleyball" = 0.82
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c(
      "Indoor volleyball" = 1.2,
      "Beach volleyball" = 2.5
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(14.5, maximum_recorded_age + 0.5),
    breaks = c(seq(15, 70, by = 5), maximum_recorded_age),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(1964, 2024, by = 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Beach volleyball records center around age 29",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Median age: ",
      beach_median_age,
      " for beach and ",
      indoor_median_age,
      " for indoor Volleyball records"
    ),
    x = "Age in source record (years)",
    y = "Olympic year",
    color = "Volleyball event"
  ) +
  guides(alpha = "none", size = "none") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6e1d8"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#355260"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = "#102f40",
      face = "bold",
      size = 17
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#667983", size = 11),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

plotly::ggplotly(volleyball_chart, tooltip = "text", height = 780) |>
  plotly::layout(
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = -0.16,
      yanchor = "top"
    ),
    margin = list(t = 105, b = 90)
  )
```

::: {.key-takeaway}
**Key takeaway:** The median recorded age is **`r beach_median_age`** for beach volleyball and **`r indoor_median_age`** for indoor Volleyball. The oldest source record is age **`r maximum_recorded_age`**—the axis previously rounded up to 75 for its five-year tick marks.
:::

One point represents a person listed for one Games and event—not a unique athlete across their career. The chart contains **`r scales::comma(nrow(volleyball_age_records))`** records from **`r scales::comma(volleyball_athlete_count)`** distinct source IDs; repeat Olympians therefore appear more than once. The source's oldest indoor Volleyball entries include coaching staff (for example, Antonio Giacobbe at age 73), so these genuine records are retained but should not be read as player ages. The source does not identify participant roles.

## The game in a few serves {#sport-primer-title}

::: {.primer-grid}
::: {.primer-card}
### Two players, one team

Each side fields a pair on a sand court. Teammates work together to keep the ball in play and send it over the net.
:::

::: {.primer-card}
### Rally scoring

A point is awarded after every rally. Matches are best of three sets: the first two go to 21 points, and a deciding set, if needed, goes to 15. A team must win a set by two points.
:::

::: {.primer-card}
### From pools to podium

In recent Olympic editions, teams begin in pool play before the knockout rounds. Qualification details vary by Games; every edition ends with one medal-winning team in each event for gold, silver, and bronze.
:::
:::
